newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's LG drops plan for Russian plant.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's LG drops plan for Russian plant.

text.p: South Korea's LG Electronics Inc said on Friday it had called off a plan to build a consumer electronics plant in Russia due to what it termed "political instability".
A spokesman for the LG Group unit said the original plan called for the investment of $200 million to build four plants in the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS).
One will be built in Kazakhstan, another in Ukraine and two were to have been built in Russia. Only one will now be built in Russia.
"We have decided to build three instead of four plants because of the political instability in Russia," he said. He did not elaborate on the political situation there.
